decisions.reason: Award-winning product with strong market validation suggests low risk of being discontinued.
Prominently featured on the homepage with enthusiastic launch language indicates strong internal support.
Only a basic website mention without notable results, implying moderate uncertainty but not yet a clear failure.
Lack of promotional emphasis or results suggests moderate risk, but first-year products typically get more time.

Basic website mention with no performance signals, indicating moderate drop risk within the first year.
